note: OpenAPI documents garde rules: #[derive(Schema)] reflects every #[garde(...)] rule with an exact JSON Schema equivalent on a type that also derives garde::Validate - length (chars mode, or min = 1 in byte/grapheme/utf16 mode; minItems/maxItems on arrays, minProperties/maxProperties on maps), range (minimum/maximum), email/url/ipv4/ipv6 (format; ip as anyOf ipv4/ipv6), pattern/prefix/suffix/contains/ascii (pattern, literals escaped, extra patterns in allOf) and inner(...) on Vec/array items or the Option value. Explicit #[schema(...)] keywords win and type-implied bounds are only tightened; alphanumeric, required, custom, matches, credit_card, phone_number, dive, if and non-literal arguments stay undocumented. #[schema(...)] and #[garde(...)] rules on Query<Struct> / Path<Struct> fields now reach the parameter schemas.
